# Mitsuhiko vendor snapshots

This directory stores small source snapshots from Mitsuhiko's Pi skill/extension repo for local reference and selective vendoring.

Tracked snapshot:

- `agent-stuff/` — copied from `https://github.com/mitsuhiko/agent-stuff`, excluding `.git`, `node_modules`, and `.DS_Store`.

This vendor copy is **not** loaded by Pi by default. The curated package that is globally installed locally is `packages/personal-core-skills`.
